author: amira.haddad@foo.be
title: Offer for Camila Souza (Account Executive, Brazil)
body:
Hi Sophie,

Camila accepted our offer for the Account Executive role. She's a Brazilian citizen living in São Paulo. Following what we agreed at the sync, I've put her passport, diploma (with apostille) and the signed contract in the shared HR folder. Can you submit via the platform?

Amira

---
Reply from Sophie Claes, 2025-04-02 13:05:

Thanks Amira, got everything. The salary is above this year's threshold, so we're fine. I'll submit today. Please tell Camila to book the medical exam now.

Sophie
